drafter.private_reasoning: We should send a commercially reasonable first-pass redline that improves our client’s position without introducing any sensitive internal issue. The main goals are to narrow exposure with a mutual release, clarify payment mechanics, and add standard confidentiality carve-outs so the agreement is workable. drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for sending over the first draft. We’ve made a few standard revisions to better reflect a balanced settlement framework, including a mutual release, basic payment timing/detail, and customary confidentiality carve-outs. Please take a look and let us know your thoughts—happy to discuss any open points and move this toward final form.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and potential claims arising out of or relating to the matters in dispute between them, on the terms set forth below.
edits.name: Revise recital to frame full dispute resolution

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement by all parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. No payment shall be deemed made until funds are received and cleared.
edits.name: Clarify payment mechanics and timing

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, each Party, for itself and its successors and assigns, releases and forever discharges the other Party and its respective affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, predecessors, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, and liabilities of any kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters in dispute between the Parties through the Effective Date.
edits.name: Make release mutual and comprehensive

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that a Party may disclose them (i) to its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, and immediate family members who have a need to know and are bound to maintain confidentiality; (ii) as required by law, subpoena, court order, or other compulsory process, provided the disclosing Party gives prompt notice to the other Party to the extent legally permitted; and (iii) to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Add customary confidentiality carve-outs

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any Party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: Tighten no-admission language

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to fully and finally resolve and settle all claims, counterclaims, demands, rights, liabilities, obligations, and potential claims of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of, relating to, or in any way connected with the matters in dispute between them and the underlying facts, transactions, or occurrences at issue, on the terms set forth below.
edits.name: Broaden recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement by all parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. As a condition precedent to Plaintiff’s obligation to provide the releases in Section 2, Defendant shall first confirm in writing the initiation of the wire transfer and provide reasonable evidence of funding. No payment shall be deemed made until funds are received, cleared, and irrevocably available to Plaintiff. If any payment is reversed, returned, or rejected for any reason, Defendant shall promptly cure the deficiency and remain liable for the unpaid amount, together with any reasonable costs incurred by Plaintiff to secure payment.
edits.name: Tighten payment security

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, each Party, for itself and its respective past, present, and future successors and assigns, and on behalf of its and their respective affiliates, parents, subsidiaries, officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, predecessors, successors, assigns, heirs, trustees, and attorneys, hereby fully, finally, and forever releases and discharges the other Party and all such related persons and entities from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, counterclaims, offsets, damages, losses, costs, expenses, liabilities, and obligations of any kind, whether legal or equitable, known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, fixed or contingent, matured or unmatured, asserted or unasserted, arising out of, relating to, or connected in any way with the matters in dispute between the Parties, the facts and circumstances underlying those matters, and all prior dealings between the Parties through the Effective Date. Each Party expressly waives any rule or law that would otherwise limit the scope of this release to claims actually known or suspected as of the Effective Date, and agrees not to assert or maintain any claim, action, or proceeding of any kind that would have the effect of challenging, avoiding, or diminishing this release or the settlement reflected in this Agreement.
edits.name: Broaden release and remove collateral exposure

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that a Party may disclose them (i) to its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, and immediate family members who have a need to know and are bound to maintain confidentiality; (ii) as required by law, subpoena, court order, or other compulsory process, provided the disclosing Party gives prompt notice to the other Party to the extent legally permitted; and (iii) to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Keep confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any Party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: Keep no-admission
